narratives.Description: feat(design-critique): every arc is GitHub-only and starts in an arc worktree from origin/default
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

Every design-critique arc (and the same for gh-arch) is GitHub-only. Bind lives on the issue thread. issue:ingest, swarm, promote, and build are later verbs, always. There is no ingest front-door mode.

Before Stop 1 or the first spawn, the parent creates one arc worktree from origin/<default> after fetch (main or master), not from local HEAD. Stop 1 records that SHA as dispatch-sha. Every child uses that dest (spawn_subagent cwd, claude / codex exec cwd). Primary occupancy never runs for the panel.

This recuts #4072: direct means this motion does not ingest. It does not mean no worktree. It recuts the earlier 4296 filing that made ingest a legal front-door mode and scoped dest to CLI-family seats only.

## Why

#4072 locked direct as no occupancy, no ingest, no worktrees. That does not compose with a Grok parent that must launch a real critic (general-purpose or grok CLI) or Claude/Codex. Those need a repo cwd. plan and explore skip dest for Grok spawn_subagent and strip git show / gh.

Primary checkout is the dest #4066 refuses. Compaction re-arm on primary is #4290. Stale local HEAD is #4291. A 3arc Grok seat on primary is #4297. The arc must not live there.

## What to build

1. Every arc resolves as GitHub-only. Closed tokens that used to mean direct / github-only / no worktrees mean no-ingest. An ingest token is not a front-door mode; it asks or refuses (wrong motion). Yolo does not pick a mode because there is no second mode.

2. Parent fetches, then git worktree add (or fast-forward a named dest) from origin/<default>. Not local HEAD. Reuse of an existing arc worktree is allowed only after fetch and a match to that tip. Against-implementation charters pin the PR head SHA, still fetched.

3. Parent may stay unclaimed on primary (read-only) and only pass cwd. Children occupy the dest, not the operator tab.

4. Arc worktree is not a swarm worktree. No active story, no product writes, no scope:activate. Process-only: GitHub comments and git show <dispatch-sha>:.

5. Grok seat is general-purpose (or grok CLI) with cwd on that dest, so tools include git show and gh. Not plan. Not explore.

6. After primary-path is gone, general-purpose still hits ritual and #2885 (no active xBRIEF). This dest class skips those the way #4241 skipped them for plan, without taking plan's tool allowlist.

7. Occupancy class stays a spawn-payload / dest-path field. Do not teach PreToolUse to read a GitHub comment.

## Rejected

- Ingest as a front-door mode
- Spawn on occupied primary as the 3arc fix (#4066 hole)
- plan or explore as the critic seat
- Per-critic worktrees (swarm Phase 2)
- YOLO default to checkout-as-ingest
- Auto-ingest
- Evidence from a dirty worktree or from unfetched local HEAD
- Occupancy cloned into run-posture by parsing Stop 1 prose

## Acceptance

- parseOperatorRunPosture: every arc is no-ingest / GitHub-only. ingest is not a resolved front-door mode.
- Parent creates or verifies one dest at origin/<default> tip after fetch before first spawn. dispatch-sha on Stop 1 equals that tip.
- Grok general-purpose spawn with cwd on that dest is allowed. Same dest for claude and codex exec. Spawn onto primary remains denied.
- No active xBRIEF is required for that spawn. Ritual on primary is not required.
- issue:ingest after bind remains a later operator verb.
- Tests pin: closed-token table, dest-from-origin-default, primary-path still denied, #2885 skip for this class, implement-class #4066 unchanged.

## Related

- #4297 -- 3arc Grok seat refused on primary; field instance for dest-first
- #4290 -- primary compaction re-arm occupancy-refuses
- #4291 -- local HEAD can be 64 behind; dest must not be that tree
- #4072 -- named direct; recut no-worktree and no ingest-mode
- #4241 -- plan dest skip; not explore; tools were supposed to remain
- #4067 -- Grok launcher tree; CLI seats
- #4066 -- implement-class dest occupancy

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-09-09T19:06:36Z)

model: grok-4.6
role: critic

Round 1. Charter refutation. Spend N=1. Ceiling 5607147331 inclusive. Pin 7609d700f6e96d9e8bf250fc0e4faeaa1331f686.

Refutation. The GitHub-only ledger and ingest-as-later-verb half already holds at this SHA: `parseOperatorRunPosture` never resolves `ingest`, and `evaluateCompletedArcRecord` ignores `arc-mode:`. Dest-from-origin/default is a real cwd pin against local HEAD. The causal joint does not hold. A dest worktree does not make primary occupancy never run, and dest-path is not a critic occupancy class. The proposed dest-class skip for `general-purpose` cannot bind as written.

Environment (this dest). cwd is `.deft-scratch/worktrees/parent-arc-4296`, a linked worktree, detached at `7609d700`, matching origin/master. `xbrief/active` is only `.gitkeep`. The same `.deft-scratch/worktrees/` prefix holds swarm story worktrees. That matches the parent measurement: dest consult can allow a linked worktree, then `spawn_subagent` `general-purpose` still dies on #2885.

### 1. Dest-path cannot be the skip class

Class: blocks-the-design

Evidence. `git show 7609d700:packages/core/src/hooks/readonly.ts`: `isProcessOnlyCriticSpawn` is true only on Grok `spawn_subagent` when `subagent_type === "plan"` (PROCESS_ONLY_CRITIC_SUBAGENT_TYPE at 266; predicate 327–356). The comment on that function is the host measurement: Grok PreToolUse stdin actually contains `subagent_type`. `git show 7609d700:packages/core/src/hooks/readonly.test.ts` 215–233 pins `general-purpose` false and pins that prompt text naming critic is not a class.

`git show 7609d700:packages/core/src/hooks/dispatcher.ts`: `decideHook` at 2530–2610 lets `plan` return `spawn-process-only-ready` and never consult dest. `general-purpose` is not explore, not plan, not ephemeral, so it falls through to `inspectMutationGates`. Consult then runs. `skipParentRitual` is `destProven === true && parentId !== "none"` (1376) — ritual on primary is already skipped for dest-proven implement spawn. Spawn has no write target, so the #2885 outside-root skip does not apply (1601–1650); recovery names `subagent_type plan`, not dest-path.

`git show 7609d700:packages/core/src/session/spawn-occupancy.ts`: plan consult returns `destProven: false` and skips dest (338–351). Implement-class denies `primary-path` (420–422). A linked worktree dest is allowed. Grok dest is `tool_input.cwd` only — the same field #4066 already requires for implement-class.

Failure mode. Horn A: skip #2885 when cwd is a proven linked worktree. Swarm implement workers already pass that dest. Horn B: skip when `subagent_type` is `general-purpose` plus dest. That is the implement worker. Horn C: classify from the critic prompt. Tests already refuse it. Horn D: copy the plan early-return for this dest class. Occupancy unique-reservation is skipped (`exemption: "process-only-critic"`), so “children occupy the dest” is false. `general-purpose` is write-capable. A read-only parent spawn of `general-purpose` is `read-only-deny` unless plan/explore (dispatcher.ts 2531–2548). Skipping #2885 without a structural write deny leaves product writes on a dest with no active xBRIEF. Envelope text is not a control.

Disposition. Name a host-visible structural marker that implement-class never sets, measured on Grok stdin the way `plan` was, or recut the Grok seat to a type that already skips. Dest-path is not that marker. Keep #4066 primary-path deny. Do not skip #2885 on destProven.

### 2. One dest plus occupy cannot compose with unique reservation

Class: blocks-the-design

Evidence. `git show 7609d700:packages/core/src/session/spawn-occupancy.ts`: live occupant is `destination-occupied` (467). `persistSpawnReservation` unique dest-lock. Body AC: same dest for Grok cwd and claude/codex exec. Rejected: per-critic worktrees. Item 3: children occupy the dest. Variant table still permits N≥3. Plan skip exists because dest occupancy is skipped, not because dest is shared.

Failure mode. Second sibling, a CLI-family seat on the same dest, or a Stop 4 retry onto a still-live dest is `destination-occupied`. The fork is the same as finding 1: skip occupancy (item 3 false; dest-path becomes the class) or unique dest per seat (rejected).

Disposition. Recut item 3 to cwd-without-occupy, with an exemption class that is not dest-path, or recut panel dest. N=1 on this arc does not make the AC true.

### 3. The causal “so” and the field grammar

Class: sharpens-framing

Evidence. `git show 7609d700:packages/core/src/design-critique/run-posture.ts`: `ARC_RUN_POSTURES` is `direct | checkout` (10). Token `no worktrees` resolves to `direct` (28, 51). `evaluateDirectDispatch` treats `worktreeAdd` as a `direct` violation (123–138). `arcModeRecordLine` emits `arc-mode: direct` or `arc-mode: checkout` only (98–100). Stop 1 on this thread recorded `arc-mode: no-ingest`, which that helper cannot emit. Item 3 is “may stay unclaimed”, not must. Dest consult is occupancy on the dest tree, not a primary-lease skip. Ingest-later is already true without dest. Body already pins against-implementation dest to the fetched PR head, not origin/default; the refutation target does not.

Failure mode. Binding “github-only” with today’s fixture forbids the dest the lean requires. Binding `no worktrees` as no-ingest while creating a worktree lies in the token. Claiming dest implies primary occupancy never runs overclaims: a later primary mutation still claims. Against-implementation dest origin is an exception the target erases.

Disposition. Collapse or retarget the closed set so github-only means no-ingest, not no-worktree. Retire or re-gloss `no worktrees`. Recut `evaluateDirectDispatch` `worktree-add`. Record `arc-mode:` as a value the parser emits. State parent-unclaimed as its own MUST. State against-implementation dest origin on Stop 1. Do not treat dest creation as occupancy clearance.

### Injection / swarm

Triggered: occupancy, identity, worktrees, envelopes, shared state. Dest cwd is the swarm dest layout. Identity must not be cwd and must not be prompt. Occupancy unique-lock is swarm Phase 2 semantics. This dest is “not a swarm worktree” only if the skip class is not dest-path. No reviewer-catch.

### Road-not-taken

Keep `plan` as the skip identity and change the host tool allowlist so `plan` has `git show` and `gh`. The body rejects that seat because plan/explore skip dest and strip those tools. That allowlist is host-owned. If Grok `plan` still strips them, this road is closed and the seat must be `general-purpose` plus a new stdin field, not a dest-path skip.

### Steelman

Strongest rejected reading: dest-from-origin/default plus primary-path deny already means the panel never occupies primary, and ingest stays a later verb. That reading is true for implement-class spawn onto primary and for ingest. It does not skip #2885 for `general-purpose`, does not create a critic class, and does not make `evaluateDirectDispatch` allow `worktree add`. Flip: measure a Grok stdin field other than `subagent_type` / `cwd` / `prompt` that implement-class never sets, and recut occupy-versus-skip as its own field.

### Footnote

Parent measurement is the code path in findings 1–2. Ritual skip is already destProven, so item 6 should not recut ritual as new work.


### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-09-09T19:07:49Z)

model: grok-4.6
role: parent

## In plain English

The GitHub-only half of 4296 already holds: ingest is a later verb, and dest-from-origin/default is a real pin against stale local HEAD. The causal "so dest means primary occupancy never runs and general-purpose is a critic" does not hold. Dest-path is not a skip class. One dest that children occupy cannot share unique reservation. Today's arc-mode grammar still treats worktree add as a direct violation.

Confirming this map recuts 4296. Ledger stays GitHub-only. Dest still comes from origin/default after fetch. The skip class must be a host-visible spawn marker implement-class never sets, measured on Grok stdin the way plan was, or the Grok seat recuts to a type that already skips and actually has git show and gh. Children get cwd without occupying. evaluateDirectDispatch must not treat worktree add as a direct violation. 4297 stays a field instance of dest-first plus primary-path deny, not a separate spawn-on-primary product.

This is not an instruction to a later builder.

Recut: next-build contract is not this body.

## Bound remedy

- Keep GitHub-only: ingest, swarm, promote, and build stay later verbs. ingest is not a front-door mode.
- Parent still fetches and creates or verifies one dest at origin/<default> tip (not local HEAD). dispatch-sha equals that tip. Against-implementation dest is the fetched PR head, recorded on Stop 1.
- Skip class is not dest-path. Name a host-visible Grok stdin marker that implement-class never sets, measured like plan, or recut the Grok seat to a type that already skips and keeps git show and gh. Do not skip #2885 on destProven. Keep #4066 primary-path deny.
- Recut "children occupy the dest" to cwd-without-occupy so N>=3 and Stop 4 can share one dest. Unique dest-lock stays for implement-class.
- Collapse the closed set so github-only means no-ingest, not no-worktree. Recut evaluateDirectDispatch worktree-add. Record arc-mode as a value the parser emits. Parent-unclaimed is its own MUST, not implied by dest create.
- Ritual skip is already destProven. Do not recut ritual as new work.
- 4297 is not a separate implementation. Same land as this recut (dest-first, primary still denied). Close as duplicate or Closes on that PR.

### Takes (critic 5607245861)

- 1 Dest-path cannot be the skip class — accept-into-contract
- 2 One dest plus occupy cannot compose with unique reservation — accept-into-contract
- 3 The causal so and the field grammar — accept-into-contract

Accepted set: 1-3. Still-open residual: none. Footnote on ritual is census only.

Non-self-arbitration: this parent authored Stop 1 5607147331. The critic was a same-family grok-4.6 CLI child on the dest after spawn_subagent died on #2885. These takes are not independent confirmation.
